flow: Server.New in cdc-cms-service initializes natsClient with Conn and JS
claim: Hàm NewNatsClient trong cdc-cms-service khởi tạo sẵn NatsClient gồm cả Conn và JS (nats.JetStreamContext) tại server.go dòng 120.

flow: EnsureStreams in centralized-data-service defines the 4 canonical JetStream streams
claim: Hàm EnsureStreams trong centralized-data-service định nghĩa 4 stream chuẩn là CDC_EVENTS, SCHEMA_DRIFT, SCHEMA_CONFIG và CDC_TRANSMUTE.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/data-hub/centralized-data-service/pkgs/natsconn/nats_client.go:67-109
	desiredStreams := []*nats.StreamConfig{
		{
			Name:      "CDC_EVENTS",
			Subjects:  cdcSubjects,
			Retention: nats.LimitsPolicy,
			MaxAge:    24 * time.Hour,
			MaxBytes:  512 * 1024 * 1024, // 512 MiB cap
			Discard:   nats.DiscardOld,
			Storage:   nats.FileStorage,
			Replicas:  1,
		},
		{
			Name:      "SCHEMA_DRIFT",
			Subjects:  []string{"schema.drift.detected"},
			Retention: nats.LimitsPolicy,
			MaxAge:    7 * 24 * time.Hour,
			MaxBytes:  64 * 1024 * 1024, // 64 MiB cap
			Discard:   nats.DiscardOld,
			Storage:   nats.FileStorage,
			Replicas:  1,
		},
		{
			Name:      "SCHEMA_CONFIG",
			Subjects:  []string{"schema.config.reload"},
			Retention: nats.LimitsPolicy,
			MaxAge:    7 * 24 * time.Hour,
			MaxBytes:  64 * 1024 * 1024, // 64 MiB cap
			Discard:   nats.DiscardOld,
			Storage:   nats.FileStorage,
			Replicas:  1,
		},
		{
			Name:       "CDC_TRANSMUTE",
			Subjects:   []string{"cdc.cmd.transmute-shadow"},
			Retention:  nats.WorkQueuePolicy, // Delete message immediately upon Ack/Term
			MaxAge:     1 * time.Hour,
			MaxBytes:   256 * 1024 * 1024, // 256 MiB cap
			Discard:    nats.DiscardOld,
			Duplicates: 2 * time.Minute,
			Storage:    nats.FileStorage,
			Replicas:   1,
		},
	}

	dual("GET", shared, "/mapping-rules", h.Shadow.Mapping.List)

	// Scheduler / Wizard

	shared.Get("/v1/wizard/sessions/:id/progress", h.Scheduler.Wizard.Progress)

	// Introspection
	dual("GET", shared, "/introspection/mongo/databases", h.System.Introspection.DiscoverMongoDatabases)
	dual("GET", shared, "/introspection/mongo/:db/collections", h.System.Introspection.DiscoverMongoCollections)

	dual("GET", shared, "/introspection/shadow-columns-with-types/:table", h.System.Introspection.ShadowColumnsWithTypes)
	dual("GET", shared, "/introspection/indexes/:table", h.System.Introspection.ListIndexes)
	dual("POST", shared, "/introspection/indexes", h.System.Introspection.CreateIndex)
	dual("DELETE", shared, "/introspection/indexes/:name", h.System.Introspection.DropIndex)

	// Alerts (optional)
	if h.System.Alerts != nil {
		dual("GET", shared, "/alerts/active", h.System.Alerts.Active)
		dual("GET", shared, "/alerts/silenced", h.System.Alerts.Silenced)
		dual("GET", shared, "/alerts/history", h.System.Alerts.History)
	}

	// Job (optional)
	if h.Scheduler.Job != nil {
		dual("GET", shared, "/jobs/:id", h.Scheduler.Job.Get)
	}

	// 4.3 ADMIN ONLY ROUTES
